name: singlet_spatial_preproc_transcript_quality_filtering
title: Transcript quality filtering and false-call estimation
description: Decides which decoded transcripts in an imaging panel are noise or misdecoded and estimates the false-call share per gene and per panel. The default control_feature_fdr drops control-class calls and calls below min_qv, then reports blank and negative-control estimates. Writes points/transcript_keep and var/false_call_rate. Use before transcript-to-cell assignment; do not use on sequencing-based spatial data, which has no decoded codewords.

dataset.description: Dataset handle (.singlet path or URI) with a transcript table and codebook metadata.

method.description: Keep rule. control_feature_fdr is the default; baysor_noise_mixture is the model-based option.

min_qv.description: Drop calls with quality value below this value; 0 disables the quality rule.

estimator.description: auto uses negative-control features when present, otherwise blank codewords.

fallback_pattern.description: Glob patterns for control features, used only when var/feature_type is absent.

prior_segmentation_confidence.description: Confidence in the prior cell mask, used when labels/<name> is supplied.

confidence_nn_id.description: Neighbours for the distance statistic; 0 selects max(n_genes/10, 10).

max_noise_posterior.description: Keep molecules whose noise posterior is at or below this value (proposed).

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA for the Baysor option when a device is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing keep flags and QC members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. points/transcript_keep. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, estimator, n_transcripts, n_removed, epsilon_blank, epsilon_nc, agreement_ratio, removed_by_class.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
